where: unnumbered display after 'est à valeurs dans un groupe'
scan: (𝔾_m(U)/𝔾_m(S̲) ⊗_ℤ ℤ_ℓ — the opening parenthesis is never closed
note: Unbalanced parenthesis in the print. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'est le composé de u_ℓ avec l'homomorphisme ℤ_ℓ^L → ℤ_ℓ'
scan: u_ℓ with no underline (the u̲_ℓ of (12.8.11) just above is clearly underlined)
note: Only the pairing u̲_ℓ of (12.8.11) takes values in ℤ_ℓ^L, so the composite is u̲_ℓ followed by ℤ_ℓ^L → ℤ_ℓ; as printed, u_ℓ is said to be the composite of u_ℓ. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

scan: plain typed Z_ℓ (the ℤ after 'sur' and every other ℤ_ℓ on the page are double-struck)
note: The typist left out the double stroke. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'on a d_λ=1 si et seulement si x est régulier au point x_λ'
scan: x in lower case (x-height, like the following 'est')
note: It is the scheme X that is regular at x_λ (next sentence: 'on a supposé X régulier, i.e. les d_λ égaux à 1'). The TeX keeps the printed lower-case x.

where: 'considérons le localisé strict complété S̲^λ de S̲ en le point maximal de D'
tex: en le point maximal de $D$, et
corrected: en le point maximal de $D_\lambda$, et
note: D = ∪ D_λ has one maximal point for each λ; S̲^λ is the localization at the maximal point of D_λ (cf. a): 'au point maximal s_λ de D_λ'). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'et X̲^λ = X ×_S S̲^λ. Alors la fibre'
scan: X̲^λ = X×_S S̲^λ: neither the X nor the subscript S is underlined; only the last S carries an underline
note: X̲^λ is the base change of f̲ : X̲ → S̲ (12.8.2) to S̲^λ, so the correct reading is X̲ ×_S̲ S̲^λ. The TeX silently underlines the subscript S (the fix restores the print) and keeps the printed plain X. In a) on the same page, P ×_S̲ D_λ, the print does underline the subscript S.

where: 'Alors la fibre spéciale X_o^λ n'a qu'un seul point singulier'
note: The special fibre of X̲^λ; the next page prints it X̲^λ_o ('en le point y_λ de X̲^λ_o'). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: diagram (12.8.15), label of the arrow M^λ → ℤ
scan: φ_{λ_λ}: a hand-drawn λ in place of the y
note: The form on M^λ is φ_{y_λ}, introduced just above the diagram. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'Or S̲ est un trait de caractéristique nulle'
scan: S̲ without the superscript λ (the preceding 'sur S̲^λ' has it)
note: S̲ carries the divisors D_λ (ℤ^L ≃ 𝔾_m(U)/𝔾_m(S̲), 12.8.10), so it is not a trait; the trait of characteristic zero over which 12.5 is applied is S̲^λ. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Remarques 12.9, 'ces cas correspondants respectivement à rang M = 1'
note: Present participle with a complement, normally invariable; a grammatical slip rather than a typing error. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
Typing error in the print. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
